title: US dollar dips as oil eases, yen jumps on Japan remarks

status.text: MOF disclosed Nov 9 that it spent a record ¥7.98trn buying yen on July 30, above the April 30 record. Yen traded near 157-159/dollar through early November; Katayama's last FX warning was Nov 2.
status.text_ja: 財務省は11月9日、7月30日の円買い介入が過去最大の7入88〉9756億円だったと公表。円は11月上旬157～159円帯で推移。片山財務相の最新の為替警戒発言は11月2日。

background.headline: Trump rejects Iran's conditional Hormuz ceasefire plan as Saudi-led coalition intercepts projectiles
background.summary: CNBC, citing the Wall Street Journal, reported that President Trump rejected Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal tied to the Strait of Hormuz, while a Saudi-led coalition intercepted incoming projectiles, keeping Middle East war-risk elevated heading into the weekend.
background.summary_ja: トランプ大統領はCNBCが報じたWSJ情報によると、ホルムズ海峡を巡るイランの条件付き停戦案を拒否した。同時にサウジ主導の連合軍は飛来物を迎撃し、中東の地政学リスクは週末を控えて高止まりした。

background.headline: Katayama says Trump raised weak-yen concerns with Takaichi at their summit; Takaichi calls undervalued yen 'problematic'
background.summary: Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said President Trump raised concern about yen weakness with PM Sanae Takaichi during their summit that week, and Takaichi said an undervalued yen was problematic in principle; USD/JPY eased below 158.50 on the remarks.
background.summary_ja: 片山さつき財務相は、トランプ大統領が高市早苗首相との首脳会談で円安への懸念を伝えたと述べ、高市首相も円の過小評価は原則として問題だとの考えを示した。この発言を受け、ドル円は158.50円を下回る場面があった。

background.headline: Katayama and Bessent hold call, reaffirm yen undervaluation remains 'a matter of concern'
background.summary: Japan's Finance Minister Katayama held a call with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, with both sides reaffirming that yen undervaluation is a matter of concern and agreeing to step up Japan-US cooperation on currency markets.
background.summary_ja: 片山財務相は米財務長官ベッセント氏と電話会談を行い、円の過小評価は懸念事項であると改めて確認したうえで、日米両国で為替分野の協力を強化することで合意した。

background.headline: BOJ raises policy rate 25bp to 1.25% in 7-2 vote, highest since 1995
background.summary: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25% at its September meeting, in a 7-2 vote, the highest level since 1995, with two board members dissenting in favour of holding.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は9月18日の金融政策決定会合で、政策金利を0.25%引き上げ1.25%とすることを7対2の賛成多数で決定した。1995年以来の高水準で、2人の委員が据え置きを主張して反対した。

background.headline: Fed raises rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% in unanimous vote, first hike since 2023
background.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16, its first increase since 2023, in a unanimous 12-0 vote, with the updated dot plot signalling one more hike was likely in 2026.
background.summary_ja: 米連邦準備制度理事会(FRB)は9月16日、フェデラルファンド金利の目標レンジを0.25%引き上げ3.75~4.00%とすることを12対0の全会一致で決定した。2023年以来初の利上げで、年内さらに1回の利上げが示唆された。

background.headline: OPEC+ core eight hold October output flat after September's 188,000 bpd increase
background.summary: OPEC+'s core eight members agreed to hold October production at September's level, pausing further increases after having raised output by 188,000 barrels per day in September.
background.summary_ja: OPECプラスの主要8カ国は、9月に日量18万8000バレルの増産を実施した後、10月の生産量を9月と同水準に据え置くことで合意した。

background.headline: Japan, US confirm rare joint yen-buying intervention conducted July 31; Bessent vows readiness for more
background.summary: Japan and the US confirmed a coordinated yen-buying intervention carried out on July 31, with Treasury Secretary Bessent saying Washington would not hesitate to take part in further joint intervention if disorderly currency moves resumed.
background.summary_ja: 日本と米国は7月31日に実施した協調円買い介入を確認した。ベッセント米財務長官は、無秩序な相場変動が再発した場合、さらなる協調介入への参加も「ためらわない」と述べた。

background.headline: BOJ holds rate at 1%, warns on inflation, same day as Japan-US joint yen intervention
background.summary: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1% while warning that core inflation could exceed its 2% target, the same day Tokyo and Washington carried out a joint yen-buying intervention.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は政策金利を1%に据え置く一方、コアインフレ率が2%目標を上回る可能性があると警告した。同日、日米は協調円買い介入を実施した。

since.headline: Japan's MOF discloses record ¥7.98trn single-day yen-buying intervention on July 30
since.summary: Japan's Ministry of Finance disclosed on Nov 9 that it spent a record ¥7.9756 trillion buying yen on July 30, surpassing the prior single-day record of ¥6.2787 trillion set April 30. The same data showed ¥5.5523 trillion spent in the Jul 31 joint intervention with the US Treasury and ¥1.8714 trillion on Aug 3.
since.summary_ja: 財務省は11月9日、7月30日の円買い介入が過去最大の7入88〉5756億円だったと公表し、4月30日の6入82〉7787億円を超えた。同日の資料では、7月31日の日米協調介入が5入55〉5523億円、8月3日が1入87〉1714億円だったことも示された。

since.headline: Katayama says Japan-US joint FX statement 'remains alive', warns against disorderly yen moves as yen slips toward 158
since.summary: Finance Minister Katayama said the joint Japan-US FX statement remains in force and that Tokyo would act against disorderly moves, after the yen weakened toward 158 per dollar on Nov 2, ending a three-day winning streak despite the renewed verbal warning.
since.summary_ja: 片山財務相は、日米の共同為替声明は「生きている」として無秩序な円相場の動きには対応すると警告したが、円は11月2日に1ドル=158円近辺まで下落し、3日続いた上昇の流れが止まった。

since.headline: BOJ holds rate at 1.25% in 8-1 vote, says underlying inflation has reached 2% target; Takata dissents for a hike to 1.5%
since.summary: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1.25% on Oct 30 in an 8-1 vote, saying underlying inflation had reached its 2% target and flagging further hikes ahead; board member Hajime Takata dissented, pushing for an immediate rise to 1.5%.
since.summary_ja: 日銀は10月30日の会合で政策金利を1.25%に据え置くことを8対1の賛成多数で決定し、基調的インフレは2%目標に達したとして今後の追加利上げを示唆した。高田創審議委員は1.5%への即時利上げを主張して反対した。

since.headline: Fed holds rate at 3.75%-4.00% in 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissent in favour of a hike
since.summary: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissenting in favour of a quarter-point hike; focus shifted to the December meeting.
since.summary_ja: FRBは10月28日、政策金利を3.75~4.00%で維持することを10対2の賛成多数で決定した。クック理事とハマック・クリーブランド連銀総裁は0.25%の利上げを求めて反対し、焦点は12月会合に移った。

since.headline: Katayama repeats readiness to take 'decisive steps' in FX market, pledges heightened vigilance
since.summary: Finance Minister Katayama said on Oct 27 that the government was prepared to take decisive steps in the currency market and would monitor moves with heightened urgency, repeating language used after earlier yen declines.
since.summary_ja: 片山財務相は10月27日、政府は為替市場で断固たる対応を取る準備があると改めて述べ、相場の動きを強い警戒感を持って注視すると述べた。

since.headline: Katayama says Japan and US agreed to step up currency cooperation after Bessent call
since.summary: Following her Sept 25 call with Treasury Secretary Bessent, Finance Minister Katayama said on Sept 29 that Japan and the US had agreed to step up coordination on yen stability.
since.summary_ja: 片山財務相は、9月25日のベッセント米財務長官との電話会談を受け、9月29日に日米が円相場の安定に向けた協調を強化することで合意したと述べた。
